description: This file is an HTML document that implements the frontend interface for a database visualizer. It includes styling, layout, and client-side JavaScript code for browsing databases, tables, and data, with features like loading indicators, error handling, and expandable cells.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases from the server and displays them in the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases, resetting current selections and reloading.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses database items and loads their tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Retrieves tables for a selected database and displays them.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads data for a selected table and renders it as a table with scrollable, expandable cells.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Constructs the HTML for displaying table data.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual cell content with handling for long strings and objects.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for better readability.
